items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: He needed two trumpets; his trumpet players--- Yeah - one trumpet player was named Handy and the other one--- Yeah - Bill Neber---

ctx.x: He just didn't want you to go --

No - so, when I was going out the door - he said, hey, kid - come back here - I want to ask you something -- he said, do you know where you can get this fellow on the phone -- and I said - you mean, Niebaur yes, I said - he is going to be Castle Farm; he should be
there now with the band -- so, he said - get him on the phone. So, I got him on the phone. He said - let me talk to him. So I..."Eddie? Wild Bill or Bill DAVISON---"

items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: Beanie got married and he had a chance to go to the Chicago Theater... he was a marvelous player

ctx.x: But, you keep calling him Neiber anyway.

Yeah - well, Niebaur---- . It's been a long time since I've used his name--- but, Beanie got married and he had a chance to go to the Chicago Theater, which was a hell of a job in Chicago. You know, where they had the symphony as well there - the Chicago Symphony Orchestra. I mean, the Chicago Theater Symphony Orchestra. And, he was a marvelous player; he married a girl named - an acrobatic dancer named Caroline LaRue---
